events.name: New Jersey Devils at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Jack Hughes and Connor Brown each had goal and two assists to help the New Jersey Devils beat the New York Rangers 6-3 on Wednesday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes and Connor Brown lead the Devils past the Rangers, 6-3

headlines.description: — Sean Walker scored with 28.3 seconds left in overtime as the Carolina Hurricanes beat Pittsburgh 6-5 on Wednesday night, spoiling Sidney Crosby’s return to the Penguins' lineup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker's OT goal lifts Hurricanes past Penguins 6-5 in matchup of Metropolitan Division's top teams

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin scored his 922nd goal and Cole Hutson scored his first to lead the Washington Capitals past the Ottawa Senators 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin scores his 922nd goal and Hutson scores in his debut as the Caps beat the Senators 4-1

headlines.description: — Jake Oettinger made 33 saves through overtime, Wyatt Johnston scored the shootout winner and the Dallas Stars beat the Colorado Avalanche...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wyatt Johnston scores shootout winner as Stars beat Avs 2-1 to tighten race for top spot in league

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Joel Farabee and rookie Matvei Gridin scored in a shootout to give the Calgary Flames a 2-1 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Farabee and Gridin score shootout goals in the Flames' 2-1 victory over the Blues

headlines.description: — Noah Cates scored on a deflection off goalie Lukas Dostal's skate at 2:17 of overtime and — after a review for offsides on the play — the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Anaheim Ducks 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noah Cates scores on an OT deflection to lift the Flyers past the Ducks, 3-2
